svg.aria-label: A POST to a topic becomes a push: 1. Config: ConfigMap ntfy-config mounts server.yml at /etc/ntfy/server.yml. It sets the base URL, the cache, attachment limits and the upstream relay. 2. Publish: A client POSTs to a topic on envoy-internal. Messages stay in the SQLite cache for 12 hours. 3. Subscribe: Subscribers hold a stream open with a keepalive every 45 seconds. iOS wake-ups go through the upstream relay at ntfy.sh. 4. Attach: Attachments expire after 24 hours, with a 50 MB limit per file and 1 GB in total, under the cache directory. 5. Keep: The auth database under /var/lib/ntfy and the cache under /var/cache/ntfy share claim ntfy, which kopiur backs up.
